messages.subject: HT-2025-000418 - CPR Part 35 instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Iqbal,

Now that proceedings are imminent, we should like to instruct you formally as the Claimant's CPR Part 35 expert. Please find attached our letter of instruction. Your earlier report of 26 September 2024 will be superseded by your Part 35 report.

The key additional question for you is representativeness - Brevdale say the 400-casting sample came disproportionately from one order. Please address how the sample was drawn and what proportion of the 1,840 population is properly to be regarded as non-conforming.

Kind regards,
James Osei

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: HT-2025-000418 - CPR Part 35 instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Thank you, instruction accepted. To be clear for the record: the 400 castings were selected at random by my laboratory across all eighteen deliveries, not from a single order. On a 78% failure rate in a sample of that size, the central estimate is about 1,435 non-conforming castings out of 1,840, with a lower 95% bound of roughly 1,354. So 'not fewer than 1,430' is well within the data and if anything conservative.

I'll have a draft report to you well before the 30 January 2026 exchange date.

Faisal
